notes.title: Roach Race development blog #1
notes.notes:
This week we have reworked The Womb. The Womb is a kind of in-game "lobby" where players wait for each other before the game begins. Players can loot the tables and corners around for weapons and items, preparing themselves for a race.

Also, we have added the latest game screenshots.
